title: Weekly Review

launchpad.outcome: Run your weekly review and choose ONE focus, with a measure and a practice plan.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What am I training next week?

slides.title: Weekly review
lines: Numbers, setups, behavior. Then pick one thing.
slides.principle: Review to find the next adjustment, not to attack yourself for the whole week.

takeaways: Choose one primary focus. One secondary at most.
remember: Review to find the next adjustment.
